exposure: CD performed during the active stage of labor
uterine niche located above the vesicovaginal fold
cesarean scar positioned below the vesicovaginal fold
cohort: 160 women with one previous term cesarean delivery
finding: Elective cesarean delivery and cesarean delivery performed in latent labor were associated with a higher incidence of uterine niche and thicker residual myometrial thickness compared to cesarean delivery during active labor.
mod_finding: The type of cesarean delivery and stage of labor at hysterotomy impact scar location, niche formation, and residual myometrial thickness.
